text_to_image_prompt: Maintain elongated legs: waist-to-toes approximately 2.5 times neckline-to-waist, tall portrait canvas leaving space for cap. Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background with soft neutral studio light. Entire items visible, realistic material texture, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand, no text or watermark. A fitted black fine vertical rib-knit round-neck long-sleeve top with long cuffs, low-rise grey-black five-pocket jeans with heavily faded thigh fronts and slim straight legs, and a pair of black leather boots with elongated pointed toes with elongated elongated slouchy folded shafts reaching just below the knees reaching just below the knees and small silver side studs. The jeans tuck into the boots. Matching black flat-top short-brim cap floats above the empty neckline; a narrow black leather belt with gold buckle is threaded through the jeans; a narrow black quilted gold-chain shoulder bag with tapered upper panel and gold interlocking-C clasp hangs at one side.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 (outfit WITHOUT accessories) is the EXACT geometry and long-leg proportion master. Image 2 (outfit WITH accessories) is a REJECTED short-legged cover; use image2 only to identify accessory placements, DO NOT copy its shortened legs. Images3–5 show accessory details. User specifically says the complete outfit cover compressed the legs and must retain the same leg length as image1. Make a corrected complete-outfit white-background product photograph by starting from IMAGE1 and adding ONLY the cap, chain shoulder bag and slim belt. CRITICAL: preserve image1's exact torso-to-leg ratios, shoulder width, waistband position relative to neckline, long hip-to-knee length, long knee-high folded leather boot shafts, boot width and elongated pointed toes. Image1's waistband-to-toe distance is approximately 2.55 TIMES the neckline-to-waistband distance; maintain this long-leg ratio, not image2's shorter ratio. Do not shrink the jeans or boots vertically to make room for the cap. Prefer EXTENDING the white canvas UPWARD to fit the cap above the empty neckline. Requested tall portrait canvas about 1024x1792 or similarly taller than 2:3; full original clothing from image1 stays uncompressed, or resize the entire ensemble uniformly as one unit if necessary. Keep the torso unchanged relative to the jeans and boots. Add a single black cadet cap above the empty neck, with modest natural empty head space; narrow black gold-buckle belt at original low waistband; black narrow diamond quilted chain bag at the side near hip. All items fully visible with white margins. No body, head, skin, hair, hands, mannequin, scenery, text or watermark. Soft studio light. The key change is LONG LEGS matching IMAGE1, including the taller boots already approved there.
